_README: Pinned validation benchmarks for the attribution pipeline. Each entry's `metric` maps to a value computed by src/attribution/validation.py from the git-tracked data/processed outputs. `category`: literature = external published anchor (with DOI in `source`); internal = self-consistency/conservation; golden = frozen pipeline output to catch silent drift. `gating`: true entries fail the build (exit 1) when out of range. Run: python3 scripts/validate_pipeline.py

benchmarks.source: Stuart-Smith et al. 2025, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09450-9 (~0.54 of warming); Ekwurzel et al. 2017, Climatic Change, doi:10.1007/s10584-017-1978-0 (~0.42-0.50 of GMST rise)
benchmarks.notes: Collective Carbon Majors share of TOTAL anthropogenic warming. Pre-denominator-fix this reads ~0.755 (fossil-CO2-only denominator applied to all-forcing warming) and FAILS by design; the total-CO2 (FFI+AFOLU) denominator fix brings it into the literature range.

benchmarks.source: Stuart-Smith et al. 2025, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09450-9 (0.7 degC of 1.3 degC, to 2023)
benchmarks.notes: Collective Carbon Majors attributed warming (our analysis is to 2020, theirs to 2023, so a slightly lower absolute value is expected).

benchmarks.source: Stuart-Smith et al. 2025, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09450-9 (Saudi Aramco ~0.04 degC heatwave-intensity contribution)
benchmarks.notes: Per-entity scale check. Passes both pre- and post-denominator-fix (~0.045 -> ~0.031), confirming the per-entity magnitude is right; the COLLECTIVE share is the drift, not the per-entity scale.

benchmarks.source: IPCC AR6 WG1 SPM: human-induced warming ~1.07 degC for 2010-2019 vs 1850-1900
benchmarks.notes: FaIR ensemble median validation against the assessed best estimate.

benchmarks.source: van Oldenborgh et al. 2021, NHESS 21:941, doi:10.5194/nhess-21-941-2021 (ERA5 FWI7x-SM probability increased by 'more than a factor of 4')
benchmarks.notes: Our GEV shift-fit primary PR vs the WWA ERA5 FWI7x-SM lower bound (>4). Not the model-FWI '>=30%' result.

benchmarks.source: van Oldenborgh et al. 2021, NHESS 21:941, doi:10.5194/nhess-21-941-2021 (FAR = 1 - 1/PR for PR>4 => FAR>0.75)
benchmarks.notes: Primary FAR consistent with WWA ERA5 FWI7x-SM lower bound.

benchmarks.source: No published probabilistic attribution exists for the Feb-Mar 2022 SE QLD floods (confirmed June 2026). Conservative lower bound from our multiplicative GEV shift-fit (CC 7%/degC x alpha=0.289).
benchmarks.notes: Sole quantitative estimate; sanity bracket only.

benchmarks.source: Derived from qld_pr (FAR = 1 - 1/PR). No external anchor.
Conservation: cm_entity_year.parquet must reproduce the raw Carbon Majors total (1854-2024). Guards the LEI-dropna class of bug (see wiki/findings/2026-06-17-lei-dropna-fix.md).
benchmarks.notes: If this fails, the entity-year aggregation silently dropped rows.

benchmarks.source: Carbon Majors 2026 release: 178 parent entities after the LEI-dropna fix.
benchmarks.notes: Drops below 178 indicate null-key dropping reintroduced.

benchmarks.source: Internal: warming_p50_degC must equal global_share * FaIR(2020) ΔT for every entity (TCRE proportionality).
benchmarks.notes: Confirms the warming columns are global_share x total ΔT and nothing decoupled them.

benchmarks.source: Internal: black_summer_scenario_totals central total must equal sum(global_share) x FAR x damages.
benchmarks.notes: Reproduces the liability identity from first principles.

benchmarks.source: InfluenceMap circulated ~1,421 GtCO2e through 2022, but the 2026 release publishes NO headline total and the figure is UNVERIFIED (see wiki/findings/2026-06-17). Informational only.
benchmarks.notes: Our load gives ~1,367 Gt through 2022; reported for transparency, not gated.

benchmarks.source: Frozen 2026-06-24 after the total-CO2 (FFI+AFOLU) denominator fix. Carbon Majors share of total anthropogenic CO2.
benchmarks.notes: Drift guard. Tighter than the literature fraction band; flags any silent change to the denominator/apportionment.
